decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The brick to be used for the raising of the height of the end gable walls shall match that of the existing buildings, and samples of all external brickwork shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced, and the development shall only be carried out in accordance with the details of materials as approved.
Condition : 3 - The pitched roofs of the two blocks of flats shall not be used to create additional floorspace on the site without the prior consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Replacement of existing flat roofs by pitched roofs and provision of 3 No. front entrance canopies to Block 2 and 2 No. front entrance canopies to Block 1
